STATEMENT OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE
REGULAR MEETING OF THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS
OF THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES HELD IN ROOM 381B
Tuesday, April 14, 2026
9:30 AM

I.   CONSENT CALENDAR
BOARD OF SUPERVISORS     1 - 3
1. Appointments to Commissions/Committees/Special Districts
Recommendations for appointment/reappointment or removal for
Commissions/Committees/Special Districts (+ denotes reappointments):
Documents on file in the Executive Office.  (26-0067)
DR Chavez addressed the Board. Interested person(s) also submitted written
testimony.
On motion of Supervisor Solis, seconded by Supervisor Hahn, this item was
duly carried by the following vote:
Ayes: Supervisor Mitchell, Supervisor Horvath, Supervisor Hahn and Supervisor Solis
Attachments: Public Comment/Correspondence

2. Motion to Proclaim May 10 through 16, 2026 as "National Prevention Week"
throughout Los Angeles County, as submitted by Supervisor Solis.  (26-2273)
Interested person(s) submitted written testimony.
On motion of Supervisor Solis, seconded by Supervisor Hahn, this item was
duly carried by the following vote:
Attachments: Motion by Supervisor Solis
Executed Document

II.   PUBLIC HEARINGS     4 - 4
4. Hearing on Ordinance Amending County Code, Title 5 - Personnel
Hearing on ordinance for adoption amending County Code, Title 5 - Personnel,
to make changes to Civil Service Rules 2, 6, 7, 8, 10, and 11.  (26-1478)
After discussion, on motion of Supervisor Mitchell, seconded by Supervisor Horvath,
the Board closed the public hearing and adopted Ordinance No. 2026-0011.

The foregoing is a fair statement of the proceedings of the public hearing meeting held
April 14, 2026, by the Board of Supervisors of the County of Los Angeles.
